title: Replay advisory decisions with a strict scripted driver
narrative: Taloneth starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`, loads the `verify_repair` durable graph (controller `scripted`, store `memory`). Evaluation and CI need a first-class scripted driver that asserts expected yield kinds and fails when unexpected advice appears. Tracks R-IOC-REPLAY and R-IOC-OFFLINE. They walk product steps (start, answer) and verify completion from the structured observation expects on this scenario. [^insp-ioc-04]
implementation: `ScriptedDriver` / `durable_generator_host.run_soft_point_session` run start/resume with soft-point bindings and `strict_unexpected_advice`.
validation: Harness `user_story` scenario `session.yaml`: environment + graph + steps + complete expects.
